subject: Ledger fork: tracebacks & VAT evidence requested by Horizon Labs
messages:
From: Lisa Tran <lisa.tran@horizon-labs.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Patel <sarah@horizon-labs.com>, billing@horizon-labs.com
Date: Tue, 20 Jun 2028 08:35:00 -0700
Subject: Ledger fork — unexpected duplicate metered lines in May invoice

Marcus,

We're seeing duplicate metered lines on our May marketplace invoice that appear to have been billed to two different seller IDs. Attached is a small usage snapshot (horizon_usage_snapshot.csv) that highlights the duplicated invoice lines. This is causing a significant VAT overcharge on our end and is triggering a withholding request with our finance team.

Can you:
- Confirm whether Redwood has two seller mappings for Horizon Labs (EU vs US) that could have both emitted the same usage rows?
- Provide a trace of the ledger entries that produced the two invoice lines (transaction IDs or marketplace consumption ids) and any VAT breakdown at the line level.

We need this evidence to open a formal dispute with the marketplace and to request a payout hold on the duplicated portion. Our procurement and billing leads are looped in.

Thanks,
Lisa Tran
Billing Ops | Horizon Labs
billing@horizon-labs.com
Attachment: horizon_usage_snapshot.csv (CSV sample, 12 rows)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Tran <lisa.tran@horizon-labs.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Sarah Patel <sarah@horizon-labs.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jun 2028 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ledger fork — unexpected duplicate metered lines in May invoice

Lisa — thanks for the heads up and for the snapshot. Im assigning this to billing ops and tax to get a fast triage. Initial asks from our side:
- Can you confirm the exact marketplace invoice number(s) and the invoice PDF(s) for May?
- Any contract Entity ID or seller-facing account number you have in the marketplace (so we can correlate the seller_id).

Naomi / Marissa / Jonas — would appreciate a quick review of the attached CSV (Lisa) and a first-pass on whether were seeing a duplicate ingestion or an entity-mapping collision. If its a marketplace-side duplicate, well need to open the dispute and prepare an evidence packet for the marketplace ops team.

Lisa, we can prepare an evidence bundle and provide a per-line VAT breakout, but we'll need to pull the marketplace consumption IDs and any corresponding internal transaction ids. I'll own coordinating with Horizon for the dispute path once we have the trace.

Marcus Lin
Lead, Marketplace Billing | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0189
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jun 2028 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ledger fork — unexpected duplicate metered lines in May invoice

Marcus / team,

Quick triage notes after pulling marketplace ingest logs (preliminary):
- Found two seller attribution entries for Horizon: seller_id=horizon-prod (primary) and seller_id=horizon-intl. Both ingested on 2028-05-31 for identical set of consumption ids.
- Root cause candidate: a marketplace listing migration on 2028-05-31 where the SKU mapping was duplicated across two listings. In our ingestion pipeline the dedupe key was the combination (timestamp, sku, customer_id) and because the seller_id changed, both records persisted.
- Impact: duplicated invoice lines for the same customer/time window; VAT applied twice on the duplicated lines.

Next steps I propose:
1) Build evidence packet with: marketplace consumption ids, internal transaction ids, CSV sample, and VAT by-line. (I attached a draft: evidence_packet_v2.pdf)
2) Open dispute with AWS/Azure/GCP marketplace (whichever invoice applies) citing duplicate consumption ids and request reversal for the duplicated lines.
3) Coordinate a payout hold on the duplicated amount until dispute resolves (per Horizon request).
4) Run a quick audit for any other accounts that might have had seller_id migration on 2028-05-31.

Questions: do we want to offer Horizon a credit up front or wait for marketplace reversal? If we offer up-front credit well need an approval from finance.

-Jonas
Jonas Weber
Marketplace Integrity Analyst | Redwood Inference
Attachment: evidence_packet_v2.pdf
Related: HubSpot 987654321, DocuSign draft for MOP amendment if they want payouts paused
From: Sarah Patel <sarah@horizon-labs.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Lisa Tran <lisa.tran@horizon-labs.com>, Procurement <procurements@horizon-labs.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jun 2028 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ledger fork — unexpected duplicate metered lines in May invoice

Marcus / Jonas,

Thanks for the quick analysis. A few clarifications from Horizon finance/procurement:
- We require line-level VAT evidence showing the original charge and the duplicated charge (consumption ids and VAT amounts).
- We are formally requesting a payout hold on the duplicated portion of the May payout until the dispute is resolved. Please confirm whether Redwood can request that via the marketplace (preferred) or whether we need to pause acceptance on our side.
- If the marketplace dispute timeline will exceed 30 days we will need an interim remediation (credit) to avoid our internal withholding escalation. We are prepared to sign a short MOP amendment if Redwood is able to provide a standard form.

Im attaching procurement here — please include the procurement contact for any DocuSign or contractual docs.

Sarah Patel
Head of Finance | Horizon Labs
Attachment: none in this message

Sarah / Lisa — we hear you and will act on the timeline below. Summary of commitments from Redwood: 

1) Evidence packet: Jonas will finalize the evidence_packet_v2.pdf with consumption ids, internal txn ids, and VAT by-line. ETA: 2028-06-24 EOD. (Attachment: evidence_packet_v2.pdf)
2) Marketplace dispute: Redwood will open the dispute with the marketplace (we will include Horizon as DRI in the dispute ticket so were aligned on messaging). ETA: 2028-06-25.
3) Payout hold: We will request the marketplace to hold the duplicated payout. If the marketplace cannot hold quickly we will propose an interim credit. Finance (Naomi) is on copy to triage the credit approval.
4) Contract amendment (MOP): We can prepare a one-page MOP amendment for Horizon to sign that allows a temporary payout hold process while disputes are open. Draft DocuSign link: DocuSign: https://www.docusign.net/preview/ABC123. If Horizon is amenable, please confirm procurement contact.

Action owners: Jonas (evidence + dispute), Naomi (finance credit approval), Marissa (customer comms), Marcus (overall coordination).

Ill follow up once the evidence packet is uploaded to the shared Drive folder and after the dispute ticket is created.

Marcus Lin
Lead, Marketplace Billing | Redwood Inference
